question: Analyze the average percentage change in sales between the 12 weeks before and after June 15, 2020, for each attribute type: region, platform, age band, demographic, and customer type. For each attribute type, calculate the average percentage change in sales across all its attribute values. Identify the attribute type with the highest negative impact on sales and provide its average percentage change in sales.
sql:
WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT 
    region, platform, age_band, demographic, customer_type,
    sales,
    week_date
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
  WHERE week_date >= '2020-03-23' AND week_date <= '2020-08-31'
),
region_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    'region' as attribute_type,
    region as attribute_value,
    (AVG(CASE WHEN week_date >= '2020-06-15' THEN sales END) - AVG(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END)) * 1.0 / AVG(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END) * 100 as pct_change
  FROM sales_data
  GROUP BY region
),
platform_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    'platform' as attribute_type,
    platform as attribute_value,
    (AVG(CASE WHEN week_date >= '2020-06-15' THEN sales END) - AVG(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END)) * 1.0 / AVG(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END) * 100 as pct_change
  FROM sales_data
  GROUP BY platform
),
age_band_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    'age_band' as attribute_type,
    age_band as attribute_value,
    (AVG(CASE WHEN week_date >= '2020-06-15' THEN sales END) - AVG(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END)) * 1.0 / AVG(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END) * 100 as pct_change
  FROM sales_data
  GROUP BY age_band
),
demographic_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    'demographic' as attribute_type,
    demographic as attribute_value,
    (AVG(CASE WHEN week_date >= '2020-06-15' THEN sales END) - AVG(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END)) * 1.0 / AVG(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END) * 100 as pct_change
  FROM sales_data
  GROUP BY demographic
),
customer_type_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    'customer_type' as attribute_type,
    customer_type as attribute_value,
    (AVG(CASE WHEN week_date >= '2020-06-15' THEN sales END) - AVG(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END)) * 1.0 / AVG(CASE WHEN week_date < '2020-06-15' THEN sales END) * 100 as pct_change
  FROM sales_data
  GROUP BY customer_type
),
all_changes AS (
  SELECT * FROM region_changes
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM platform_changes
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM age_band_changes
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM demographic_changes
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM customer_type_changes
)
SELECT 
  attribute_type,
  AVG(pct_change) as avg_pct_change
FROM all_changes
GROUP BY attribute_type
ORDER BY avg_pct_change
